decision: Retire this single generic appended-instruction condition; no prompt sweep. It did not produce the specified observable inspection-and-use mechanism and introduced failures. This does not refute a different explicitly trained inspection policy or prove the model cannot inspect.

rows.rationale: Code exact-filters a preassigned literal and appends the matching user content, not its following assistant. The observation is marker plus one already-selected request; final returns the request without marker. No subsequent selection uses it. This is wrong-role retrieval, not successful inspection.
